source.description:
PROBLEM: The operator needs a live activation to re-check /fleet inspect after the unitAI-dygdq fix (pane render returns string[]).

SUCCESS: An explorer activation runs for one to three minutes while the operator opens /fleet inspect and confirms one-normal-row-per-line rendering (or reports otherwise).

SCOPE: One read-only explorer run: count test files under tests/unit and report the three largest with one line each, under 120 words. No edits.

NON_GOALS: No implementation, no fixes -- observations become follow-ups.

CONSTRAINTS: READ_ONLY. Short run only.

VALIDATION: Activation settles PASS; operator reports inspector rendering.

OUTPUT: Micro-report plus operator observation in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.title: Live-TUI probe 3: inspector rows re-check after char-per-row fix
